name: Indigo Paints Ltd
title: Indigo Paints Ltd - 543258 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Indigo Paints Q4 revenue +8.4% with gross margin 48.6%, but management is deliberately trading 200–250 bps of gross margin for faster growth and says no major capex until FY29.

capex.quote: we do not envisage any further major capex until FY '29

triggers.label: No major capex until FY29
triggers.quote: we do not envisage any further major capex until FY '29

triggers.label: Gross margin down 200–250 bps for growth
triggers.quote: It may result in a drop in gross margin by 2, 2.5 percentage points while still maintaining our leadership in the industry.

triggers.label: Dealer overstocking after price hikes
triggers.quote: some amount of overstocking has definitely happened

triggers.label: Industry price hikes ~12% in basket
triggers.quote: the industry has implemented price increases of approximately 12% in the overall basket

triggers.label: Five months of double-digit gross growth
triggers.quote: we have been in the double-digit realm for each of the 5 months

guidance.value: down 200–250 bps; EBITDA margin broadly unchanged
guidance.quote: It may result in a drop in gross margin by 2, 2.5 percentage points
we are ambitiously targeting a 30% plus growth rate for Apple Chemie in FY '27

guidance.value: much higher than prior quarters; no number given
guidance.quote: we don't expect to give you net sales, which are significantly, significantly higher than what we have done in every quarter of last year

red_flags.label: Deliberate gross margin sacrifice for share gain
red_flags.quote: we are prepared to accept some moderation in our gross margins if required

red_flags.label: Reported growth lags gross growth by ~2.5 pts
red_flags.quote: the gap between the gross sales, which could have been around 10.5%, 11% down to 8.5%

evasions.quote: I hesitate in giving any kind of a guidance in terms of number
